LanguageData.MW_CommandChooseWeaponDesc: Pick a weapon on this map for a hauler to bring here and mount. A weapon already on the mount is dropped beside it when the new one is installed.
LanguageData.MW_CommandCancelWeaponDesc: Stop waiting for the chosen weapon to be brought here.
LanguageData.MW_CommandRemoveWeaponDesc: Take the weapon off the mount and drop it beside it.
LanguageData.MW_NoMountableWeapons: No mountable weapons on this map
LanguageData.MW_TargetOutsideArc: Target is outside the mount's firing arc.
LanguageData.MW_InspectPending: Waiting for a hauler to install: {0}
LanguageData.MW_InspectUnmanned: Needs a colonist to man it
LanguageData.MW_CoreLost: The {0} inside the {1} was destroyed with it.
LanguageData.MW_CoreSurvived: The {0} survived the destruction of the {1}.
LanguageData.MW_Settings_ResetTip: Return every value on this tab to its default. The other tabs are left alone.
LanguageData.MW_Settings_MannedArcHint: Total angle a manned mount can fire across, centred on the direction it faces. The gunner stands behind it, so they can't swing it round past themselves.
LanguageData.MW_Settings_AutomatedArcHint: Total angle an automated mount can fire across, centred on the direction it faces.
LanguageData.MW_Settings_WeaponDamage: Most damage to the mounted weapon
LanguageData.MW_Settings_WeaponDamageHint: The weapon drops beside the wreck and loses a random share of its hit points, up to this much. It is never destroyed this way.
LanguageData.MW_Settings_CoreLossHint: For automated mounts destroyed in combat. Deconstructing a mount always returns its core.
LanguageData.MW_Settings_CenterWeapons: Center weapon art on the mount
LanguageData.MW_Settings_CenterWeaponsHint: Turns the weapon around the middle of its art instead of the middle of its texture. Fixes weapons like the minigun that are drawn off to one side.
LanguageData.MW_Settings_MannedIntro: Values for each manned mount. Changes apply to mounts already built.
LanguageData.MW_Settings_AutomatedIntro: Values for each automated mount. Changes apply to mounts already built.
LanguageData.MW_Settings_StabilityHint: Share of the gunner's misses the mount turns into hits, per cell of distance.
LanguageData.MW_Settings_AccuracyHint: A level 8 shooter is about 96%, level 14 about 98%.
